title: Theater of Dreams
description: A large metallic theatrical mask floats centrally above a surreal night cityscape. The mask features glowing purple neural branches growing from its forehead, film strips and lanterns along its edges, while below it a green-draped table holds potions and gold coins amid Victorian buildings, floating figures, and a vibrant purple neural tree against a starry sky.
